phases.title: Reconcile sources and freeze executable requirements
tasks: Read full current source and developer documents listed in sources.md.
Run read-only node/mode inventory; pin reference code, model, tokenizer and GGUF hashes.
Resolve ambiguous length, mask, trace and existing-defect semantics into fixtures before implementation.

phases.title: Portable model graph and step-contract core
tasks: Port the smallest reference-correct graph using existing ggml operators and Gemma4 helpers.
Move all mutable request state to contexts; implement explicit forward/sample/commit operations.
Use tiny adversarial fixtures and CPU sanitizers before adding custom CUDA kernels.

phases.title: Basic earlier-CDG functionality on real weights
tasks: Bring up native load, text sampling, Tier-0 frames, cleaned output and trace rendering through a minimal test client or facade adapter; full current-node certification belongs to I4.
Validate real original/GGUF/Q8/Q4 fixed-input parity and multi-canvas generation.
Offer a hands-on experiment checkpoint; do not classify operator satisfaction as a technical pass.

phases.title: Limited current workflows and observability
tasks: Implement persistent worker, core adapter, constraints, control walker and budgeted full capture.
Keep observation independent of sampling/stopping; profile copy and retention costs.
Offer a hands-on constraint/trace checkpoint while marking missing node capabilities explicitly.

phases.title: All current nodes and MCP parity
tasks: Implement encode/advance/inject/compose with immutable borrowed caches and registry lifetime rules.
Execute all eight nodes and every frozen supported mode in real ComfyUI graphs.
Keep unimplemented research interfaces capability-gated; no image implementation.

phases.title: Distribution candidate, not automatic publication
tasks: Re-run all cumulative tests on the exact candidate and certify only measured host/backend pairs.
Build checksummed binaries with complete source/patch/license provenance and verify clean installation.
Prepare narrow upstream review slices; never automatically submit a PR or publish a release.
